In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the dataset is an important contribution for the vehicular networking community, as it provides the first realistic mobility trace that captures the macroscopic and the microscopic dynamics of car traffic in large urban areas.
the dataset is a valuable resource for the vehicular network community, as it can be used to evaluate network solutions in a more realistic and comprehensive manner.

the dataset is a very useful tool for the evaluation of vehicular network protocols and algorithms, and it can be employed to assess the impact of mobility on the performance of such protocols and algorithms.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

, while the current state-of-the-art in vehicular mobility models has been able to reproduce the macroscopic dynamics of road traffic, it has been unable to capture its microscopic dynamics, and thus to properly model the vehicular mobility.

we provide the research community with a new, large-scale vehicular mobility dataset that captures the main features of real vehicular traffic, and we demonstrate how this dataset can be employed to improve the simulative evaluation process.
, in order to properly evaluate vehicular network protocols, it is necessary to employ a mobility dataset that is both realistic and comprehensive.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the lack of a large-scale realistic vehicular mobility dataset has led to the evaluation of vehicular network protocols on unrealistic mobility scenarios, which may have biased the performance analysis.
, in order for the vehicular network research community to make a leap forward in terms of performance evaluation, a comprehensive mobility dataset is needed.

, when evaluating network protocols, vehicular mobility should not be considered as a static feature of the network but, rather, as a dynamic and complex phenomenon that has to be carefully accounted for.
